user.title: Select existing Home Assistant entities
user.description: This integration does not talk to Tesla directly. It controls your existing Tesla Fleet / Tesla Fleet Extra entities and your local solar/grid sensors.

data_description.grid_net_power: Must be positive for grid import and negative for export, in watts.
data_description.forecast_tomorrow: Optional Forecast.Solar 'Estimated energy production - tomorrow' sensor in kWh. Leave empty to disable forecast-aware 83% buffering.
data_description.charge_cable: Used to detect a real physical OFF→ON plug-in. This gives a short immediate solar-start window; HA startup/reload while already plugged in does not count.
Used to detect a real physical OFF→ON plug-in. This gives a short immediate solar-start window; HA startup/reload while already plugged in does not count.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Tesla Solar Controller instance is supported.

init.title: Controller settings
init.description: Tune the controller without YAML. A fresh physical plug-in can start solar charging immediately; later restarts use SOC hysteresis.

data.min_solar_production_w: Minimum solar production for solar start (W)

data_description.maintenance_start_soc: Default 78%. Accessory use can trigger maintenance only at or below this SOC.
data_description.buffer_target_soc: Default 83%. This target is only used with poor next-day forecast and enough solar surplus while the car is already awake.
data_description.notify_service: Example: notify.mobile_app_tam14p. Leave empty to disable charging notifications.
data_description.solar_wake_delta_soc: Default 3 points. Outside the fresh plug-in window, with an 80% normal target, new solar charging may start at 77% or lower, but not at 78-79%.
data_description.recent_plug_window_minutes: Default 10 minutes. During this window, a real OFF→ON cable connection may start charging immediately when export is already sufficient and SOC is below the configured normal target. Afterward, SOC hysteresis governs new solar starts.
data_description.min_solar_production_w: Default 300 W. Fresh plug-in starts and later solar wake/restart events require both enough grid export and at least this much measured solar production. Missing/low solar production cannot wake the vehicle.
